cards.ex: That new pop song has a really catchy tune; I can't get it out of my head!
cards.exUz: Yangi pop qo'shiqning ohangi juda yodda qolarli; uni xayolimdan chiqarolmayapman!
cards.uzDef: Oson esda qoladigan va yoqimli ohang, musiqa.

cards.ex: The actor received a standing ovation after his amazing performance.
cards.exUz: Aktyor o'zining ajoyib ijrosidan so'ng tik turib olqishlandi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlarning minnatdorchilik belgisi sifatida tik turib qarsak chalishi.

cards.ex: The new superhero movie is expected to be a box office hit.
cards.exUz: Yangi superqahramonlar filmi katta kassa yig'ishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Katta daromad keltirgan, kassada muvaffaqiyat qozongan film.

cards.ex: She landed the starring role in the new Broadway musical.
cards.exUz: U yangi Brodvey musiqiy filmida bosh rolni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Filmdagi yoki spektakldagi eng muhim, asosiy rol.

cards.ex: The play received rave reviews from all the major newspapers.
cards.exUz: Spektakl barcha yirik gazetalardan maqtovga sazovor sharhlar oldi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalari tomonidan berilgan juda ijobiy sharhlar.

cards.ex: The concert sold out within hours of tickets going on sale.
cards.exUz: Konsertga biletlar sotuvga chiqqanidan bir necha soat ichida sotib tugatildi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha biletlarni sotib tugatish, hech qanday bilet qoldirmaslik.

cards.ex: The comedian said it was a tough crowd; nobody was laughing.
cards.exUz: Komikachi bu talabchan tomoshabin ekanligini aytdi; hech kim kulmadi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin, talabchan tomoshabinlar, ularni xursand qilish qiyin.

cards.ex: The young actress stole the show with her amazing performance.
cards.exUz: Yosh aktrisa o'zining ajoyib ijrosi bilan shouni o'g'irladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq e'tibor qozonish, eng yaxshi chiqish qilish.

cards.ex: The movie had me on the edge of my seat the whole time.
cards.exUz: Film meni butun vaqt davomida hayajonda ushlab turdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda hayajonli, sabrsizlik bilan kutish holati.

cards.ex: I find some modern art a bit too artsy fartsy for my taste.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi zamonaviy san'at men uchun biroz san'atkorona.
cards.uzDef: O'zini san'atkor qilib ko'rsatadigan, lekin aslida unchalik emas.

cards.ex: I didn't think they could pull off such a complex play, but they did!
cards.exUz: Men ularning bunday murakkab o'yinni uddalay olishiga ishonmagan edim, lekin ular buni uddalashdi!
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki kutilmagan narsani muvaffaqiyatli bajarmoq.

cards.ex: She's been in the limelight ever since she won the singing competition.
cards.exUz: U qo'shiq tanlovida g'alaba qozonganidan beri diqqat markazida.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy e'tibor markazida, mashhur bo'lish.

cards.ex: Getting that movie role was her big break.
cards.exUz: O'sha filmdagi rolni olish uning katta imkoniyati edi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan muhim imkoniyat.

cards.ex: The funny video went viral and now everyone is talking about it.
cards.exUz: Qiziqarli video ommabop bo'lib ketdi va endi hamma bu haqda gapiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Internetda juda tez tarqalmoq va mashhur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He was playing air guitar to his favorite rock song.
cards.exUz: U o'zining sevimli rok qo'shig'iga havo gitarasi chalayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqani eshitayotganda hayolan gitara chalish harakatini qilish.

cards.ex: The director calls the shots on set.
cards.exUz: Direktor sahnada buyruq beradi.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish huquqiga ega bo'lmoq, boshqaruvchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: His performance was a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uning ijrosi takrorlash qiyin edi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik yaxshi ish qilganki, undan keyin qilish qiyin.

cards.ex: These reforms will set the stage for economic growth.
cards.exUz: Ushbu islohotlar iqtisodiy o'sish uchun zamin yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir sodir bo'lishi uchun sharoit yaratmoq.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what he really thinks.
cards.exUz: Uning nima deb o'ylayotganini tushunish uchun qatorlar orasini o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan ma'noni tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Let's go out and paint the town red!
cards.exUz: Kel, tashqariga chiqib, xursandchilik qilaylik!
cards.uzDef: Xursandchilik bilan kechani o'tkazmoq, ko'ngil ochmoq.

cards.ex: The guitar was out of tune, so it sounded terrible.
cards.exUz: Gitara noto'g'ri sozda edi, shuning uchun yomon eshitildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri notalarda kuylash yoki o'ynash.

cards.ex: His bad cooking is a standing joke in our family.
cards.exUz: Uning yomon ovqati bizning oilamizda doimiy hazildir.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda aytiladigan hazil, hamma biladigan.

cards.ex: I'm really getting into jazz music lately.
cards.exUz: Men yaqinda jaz musiqasiga qiziqib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga qiziqishni boshlash, yoqtirib qolish.

cards.ex: Everyone is singing her praises after she saved the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyani qutqarganidan keyin hamma uni maqtamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda maqtash, uning yaxshi tomonlarini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I was totally starstruck when I met my favorite actor.
cards.exUz: Men sevimli aktyorim bilan uchrashganimda butunlay hayratda edim.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur insonni ko'rganda hayajonlanish va hayratda qolish.

cards.ex: Convincing him to go to the opera will be a tough sell.
cards.exUz: Uni opera teatriga borishga ko'ndirish qiyin savdo bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sotish yoki ishonish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: His success was just a flash in the pan; he quickly faded away.
cards.exUz: Uning muvaffaqiyati vaqtinchalik edi; u tezda yo'qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida muvaffaqiyatga erishgan, lekin davomi yo'q narsa.

cards.ex: I've had that song on repeat all day.
cards.exUz: Men bu qo'shiqni butun kun davomida takrorlab eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda takrorlanadigan, qayta-qayta eshitiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The movie didn't really live up to the hype.
cards.exUz: Film haqiqatan ham kutilganidek bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan aytilgan umidlarni oqlamoq.

cards.ex: I always get stage fright before I have to speak in public.
cards.exUz: Men har doim omma oldida gapirishimdan oldin sahna qo'rquviga tushaman.
cards.uzDef: Sahnaga chiqishdan oldin asabiylashish va qo'rqish.
